description: A self-hosted command center for OpenCode. Sessions, git, terminal, and schedules in one web app, from your phone or desktop.

latest_release.name: OpenCode Manager v1.1.0
latest_release.body:
## Highlights

- **Linked OpenCode servers**: pair any machine running `opencode serve` with `ocm link` and a QR code, then run sessions, terminals, schedules, multi-runs, goals and permission modes on it from Manager. Linked servers' projects appear on the home page.
- **Repository secrets and variables**: GitHub Actions–style global, repository and environment secrets and variables, mapped through `.ocm/project.json` into agent shells, terminals, project actions and sandboxed shells, with secret values masked in tool output.
- **QR device pairing**: Settings → Account → Connect a device signs in a phone or browser with a QR code, each with its own session.
- **Sandboxed schedules**: a schedule can run each run in its own microVM, with optional CPU and memory limits.
- **Voice conversation mode**: hands-free talk with the agent from the composer, with replies read aloud (now also on iOS).
- **Offline start**: the app restores the signed-in session and cached lists before the network answers.
- **Sessions tool panel**: on desktop the session picker lives in the right tool panel, replacing the Activity tool.

## What's Changed

### Features

- **feat(servers): link remote OpenCode servers with QR pairing (#442, #445)**: terminals, notifications, permission modes, goals, multi-runs and schedules on linked servers; shared model favorites, recents and variants; a compact server switcher. The separate server page is replaced by linked-server projects on the home page.
- **feat(secrets): repository secrets and variables for agent shells and terminals (#432)**: a Secrets tool on repository pages, a global section in Settings → OpenCode Config, and the env mapping shown in trust review.
- **feat(device-pairing): pair phones and browsers with a QR code (#461)**
- **feat(schedules): run scheduled jobs in a per-job sandbox microVM (#469)**
- **feat(frontend): hands-free voice conversation mode in the composer (#459)**
- **feat(frontend): persist the query cache and restore the signed-in session offline (#463)**
- **feat(sessions): move the session picker into the desktop right tool panel (#471)**
- **feat(frontend): mobile sessions sheet and session details header (#462)**, with context usage on the composer model pill.
- **feat(frontend): restyle the session transcript as a plain log with collapsible tool details (#457)**
- **feat(frontend): composer layout refresh and activity scanner under the composer (#454)**
- **feat(frontend): in-row mobile voice recorder (#456)** and **mobile add-repo action in the search row (#458)**
- **feat(sessions): full-screen mobile question sheet with persisted draft answers (#447)**
- **feat(navigation): drag-resizable desktop sidebar (#443)**
- **feat(header): move mobile reports into the More menu and compact the header (#444)**
- **feat(chat): dedicated card for Code Mode `execute` calls and images returned by tools (#440)**
- **feat(ocm-cli)**: `ocm link`, `ocm login --name`, and warp replaces the `ocm` process with `opencode`.

### Fixes

- **fix(auth): update the auth stack, make session revocation immediate and stop logging tokens (#455)**; auth rate limiting keys on the socket address only.
- **fix: issues found in a full desktop and mobile evaluation (#460)**: TTS on iOS, STT endpoints with a trailing `/v1`, terminal output capture, git identity validation.
- **fix(events): clear stale pending questions from remote servers (#451, #452)**
- **fix(ocm-cli): detect the OpenCode service in `ocm link` (#449)**
- **fix(sessions): keep the question card within the space above the prompt (#448)**
- **fix(git): refresh branch labels after branch changes (#439)**
- **fix(notifications): phrase permission labels without losing acronyms (#466)**
- **fix(schedules): fill available panel height with the jobs table (#467)**
- **refactor(activity): remove the compact activity list from the mobile More drawer (#468)**
- **fix(frontend): collapse the linked-server project header when a tool panel is docked**

detail.readme:
OpenCode Manager

A self-hosted command center for OpenCode. Sessions, git, terminal, and schedules in one web app, on your desktop and your phone.

opencodemanager.app · Docs · Releases

## Quick Start Requires Docker with Compose v2. ```bash curl -fsSL https://opencodemanager.app/install | sh ``` The installer starts OpenCode Manager on http://localhost:5003 and asks before sharing anything from your machine. Re-run it to update. On first launch you create an admin account. Requirements, Compose and source installs, and every feature are covered at **[opencodemanager.app](https://opencodemanager.app)**: - [Installation](https://opencodemanager.app/docs/getting-started/installation) - [Features](https://opencodemanager.app/docs/features/overview) - [Configuration](https://opencodemanager.app/docs/configuration/environment) - [`ocm` CLI](https://opencodemanager.app/docs/ocm-cli) - [Troubleshooting](https://opencodemanager.app/docs/troubleshooting) ## Development This repository is a pnpm workspace: `backend/` (Bun + Hono), `frontend/` (React + Vite), `shared/` (schemas and types) and `ocm-cli/` (the `ocm` CLI). ```bash pnpm install pnpm dev pnpm lint pnpm typecheck pnpm test ``` See the [Development Guide](https://opencodemanager.app/docs/development/setup) for setup, scripts, database notes and testing. ## License MIT
